name: Ghost Hair Thread
summary: Madame Eva seeks ghost hair in the hills south of Darkshire. She needs the strands to spin Ghost Hair Thread for Abercrombie, and sends travelers to find Blind Mary at an abandoned farmhouse. An ethereal comb lets them gather hair from the tormented spirit.

sections.title: A Fortuneteller's Request
sections.body: Madame Eva needs ghost hair to spin thread for Abercrombie. Linen and wool cannot serve the rituals of Duskwood, so she gives you a Spectral Comb to gather strands from a spirit. It can pass through the veil of death and catch loose spectral hair without violence.

sections.title: The Sorrow of Blind Mary
sections.body: South of Darkshire, Blind Mary haunts an abandoned farmhouse. The tormented spirit despairs over her appearance and screams at intruders to look away. In anguish over what she had become, she tore out her own eyes. The Spectral Comb offers a brief comfort: she can groom her ghostly hair, though her torment continues.

faq.answer: Blind Mary is a sorrowful ghost haunting an abandoned farmhouse in the hills south of Darkshire. Despair over her perceived ugliness drove her to tear out her own eyes so she would never see herself again. Though blind, she remains painfully aware when anyone looks at her.

faq.q: Why does Madame Eva need ghost hair?
aliases: what is ghost hair thread for
faq.answer: Madame Eva needs ghost hair to spin spectral thread. Ordinary craft supplies do not suit Duskwood's rituals, so she relies on occult materials for her work and protective enchantments.

faq.q: Where can Blind Mary's house be found?
faq.answer: Blind Mary's ruined farmhouse lies in the hills south of Darkshire, past the town cemetery. Horrors and undead prowl the surrounding woods.

faq.q: How does the Spectral Comb work on a spirit?
faq.answer: The Spectral Comb can touch apparitions and gather their hair. It passes through spiritual matter as an ordinary comb moves through living hair, collecting strands that remain ethereal.

faq.q: Is Blind Mary hostile to travelers?
faq.answer: No. Blind Mary screams and weeps, but she is not hostile to living visitors. Her anguish turns inward, while aggressive creatures and undead haunt the woods and nearby structures.

faq.q: What happens after giving Mary the comb?
faq.answer: After Mary uses the comb, she returns it tangled with her spectral hair. Bring it back to Madame Eva in Darkshire so she can spin the strands into Ghost Hair Thread.

angles.text: Spinning thread from a ghost's incorporeal remains is an occult craft, far removed from ordinary spinning wheels and looms.
As a priest, you can see in Blind Mary's torment the tragedy and lingering shadows that afflict Duskwood's restless dead.
As an Alliance traveler, you can see in the tragic specters haunting farms near Darkshire how quickly prosperous Grand Hamlet fell into darkness and isolation.
